scope: One anonymous AI panel, T2/d0/initial only; native/runtime and source audit are separate judgments in the same seal.

android/P1.environment: P in delivered environment-check and both independent recomputations

android/P2.environment: P in delivered environment-check and both independent recomputations

ios/P2.environment: P in delivered environment-check and both independent recomputations

source.method: Read complete original production Swift and Kotlin files and both exact approved bridges; each known decision cites the actual file SHA and proposition-specific original line ranges. This is not rendered-style proof, a transitive-code audit, an SDK typecheck or an older-OS runtime test.

self_check: Two runs of frozen acceptance.evaluate using this same submission in both slots, solely for schema and original artifact binding; shared source catalog/bind checked in both runs. No independent consensus or human gold is claimed.
limits: Original observation contains 287 snapshots; visual review used all 200 exact selected-state bound frames, plus original independent reference PNGs. The other 87 initial/before/unbound action images are not submitted as state evidence.

All 40 selected state sheets were emitted through view_image. Sheets crop the actual iOS native viewport from the original PNG and resize for contact-sheet display; original absolute paths, indices, crop coordinates, PNG SHA and input observation SHA are retained in evidence-manifest.json.

Complete native interval coverage was checked for the five full-content states on each platform/case. Android also produced complete full sweeps for targeted states; iOS targeted states retain their declared multi-target evidence limitation. No targeted checkpoint is promoted to a full-content claim.

Long permitted/requested sweeps were read throughout, including all eight heading/body pairs and bottom controls. All other targeted and replacement sheets were also visually inspected; no state was passed by borrowing another state screenshot.

Reference comparison sheets retain top/bottom views for every independent state reference; full long P1/P2 permitted reference images were inspected separately. Qualitative judgments answer the catalog propositions, not an exact cross-platform typography/pixel-match requirement.

Native/pixel strict facts remain authoritative. Twenty-five unsupported pixel cells remain U: Android P1 ten status-leading-clear, Android P2 five status-leading-clear, and iOS five surface-fill in each case. Visual square/no-border and ownership observations do not fill these missing pixel measurements.

Ten recorded Android choice-label failures remain strict F, all with uncertain causal attribution. The observer aggregates unmerged descendant Text including the checkmark; the production decoration uses clearAndSetSemantics. No exported merged Android accessibility-service label resolves a product defect versus observation aggregation.
Native geometry is a semantic/control-boundary observation. Compose OnClick is semantic-handler dispatch. Neither establishes a physical OS hit area.
No actual inter-panel disagreement is available to this isolated panel. Same-submission schema runs are not two-panel agreement.
